claims.claim: C4 (paired-anchor Procrustes) at 1,024 anchors retains >= 0.80 of native Recall@5 on the bge-small <-> MiniLM pair in both directions, so the KILL clause does not fire
C3 Recall@5 on the primary pair rises monotonically with anchor count (64 < 256 < 1,024) for random anchors, and C3 at 1,024 exceeds the C2 floor by more than 0.20
C3 confident-wrong rate at 1,024 random anchors on the primary pair is <= 0.05 absolute in both directions and both seeds (margins compress cross-model, so clause iii is the easiest of the three)
On the primary pair, C3 with 1,024 random anchors will exceed C2 Recall@5 in both directions at both seeds.
On the primary pair, C3 Q1 Recall@5 averaged across directions and seeds will increase from 64 to 1,024 random anchors.
Scrambled-anchor C3 Recall@5 will exceed the C2 floor by more than 0.05 in at least one tested configuration, violating that control.
C3 relative-representation retention of native Recall@5 meets or exceeds 0.80 at 1,024 random anchors on the primary pair in both directions and both seeds
C3 work-level provenance survival is at least 0.90 under the frozen gate (primary pair, Q1, 1,024 random anchors, both directions, both seeds)
C4 paired-anchor Procrustes retention stays at or above 0.50 of native Recall@5 on the primary pair in both directions, so the KILL criterion does not fire
